Ask both to retell the same old classroom case and use the same scoring criteria.
en.answer: Give both the same new case and use the same scoring criteria.
en.explanation: The same new case tests transfer under matching task and scoring conditions. Different-difficulty cases do not meet the stated comparison requirement. Retelling an old case keeps conditions matched but does not test application in a new context.

en.question: A survey invites only current paying users. Of 100 respondents, 90 report satisfaction; former users are not surveyed. Which group does the 90% most directly describe?

en.question: A survey aims to understand all former or current paying users, including those still paying and those who left. It currently samples only the still-paying list; complete lists of both groups are available. Which change gives both target groups a chance of selection?

Increase the random sample from the still-paying list.
Sample randomly only from the list of users who left.
en.answer: Sample randomly from the full list of everyone who has paid.
en.explanation: The full ever-paid list includes both groups and gives each a chance of selection. A larger still-paying sample leaves departed users out; a departed-only sample leaves current users out. en.question: In each of two years, a place has 10,000 residents and 100 separately recorded cases. News coverage rises from 20 articles to 200. Using cases ÷ population, which ratio gives this year's case rate?
en.explanation: The case rate is 100 cases divided by 10,000 residents, or 1%. The 200 articles are not 200 separate cases; 200 ÷ 20 measures the increase in article count, not the case rate.

zh.question: 某地两年人口都为1万人，每年独立记录的案件都为100起；新闻报道却从20篇增至200篇。按“独立案件数÷人口”计算，今年的案件率应使用哪一比率？
zh.explanation: 案件率用案件数100除以人口10000，得到1%。200篇是报道量，不是200起独立案件；200÷20是报道量的倍数，不能当成案件率。

en.question: In each of two years, a place has 10,000 residents and 100 separately recorded cases. News coverage rises from 20 articles to 200. Using cases ÷ population, which ratio gives this year's case rate?
en.explanation: The numerator is 100 cases and the population is 10,000: 100 cases per 10,000 residents that year, or one per 100. Repeated cases may involve the same person, so this is not the percentage of residents affected. The 200 reports and their tenfold increase are different quantities.

zh.question: 某地两年人口都为1万人，每年独立记录的案件都为100起；新闻报道却从20篇增至200篇。按“独立案件数÷人口”计算，今年的案件率应使用哪一比率？
zh.explanation: 案件数100除以人口10000，对应一年每万人100起，或每100人1起。案件可能涉及同一人多次，不能把这个事件率直接说成1%居民遇案。200篇是报道量；200÷20是报道量倍数，都不是给定定义的案件率。
